# Sub-base Locations Live Verification Fixture

This fixture contains a clear place hierarchy and place-to-place containment.
It intentionally also mentions characters, an object, and an ability as
DISTRACTORS — none of them should be extracted as entities by the
`sub-base-locations` profile, and no non-containment relationships should be
persisted.

## The universe

The cosmos of Aeltharûn is the whole of existence in this story. Within it lies
a single inhabited world, the planet Var Solethi.

## Continent and realm

Var Solethi has one charted continent, Or'Dahl. On Or'Dahl stands the Kingdom of
Bael Turim, a realm that governs the continent's northern half.

## Region, city, structure, dwelling

In the Kingdom of Bael Turim there is a mountainous region called the Thornmarch.
The Thornmarch holds the walled city of Kesh Amara. Kesh Amara is a warden-hold,
a settlement rank unique to Bael Turim that ranks between an ordinary city and a
royal fortress. Inside Kesh Amara, at its centre, rises the Obsidian Spire, a
fortress-tower of black glass. On the top floor of the Obsidian Spire is the
Warden's Chamber, a small circular room where records are kept.

## Distractors (must NOT be extracted)

The archivist Dorian Vale lives in the Warden's Chamber and keeps a silver moon
pendant locked in a copper box there. His colleague Mira Stonewell can read
memories by touch, an ability the wardens call farsight. Dorian trusts Mira, and
the two are allies.

## A plot-central unnamed space (SHOULD be rescued with a descriptive name)

Beneath the Obsidian Spire is a cellar. It has no name. In the first chapter the
old archivist is found dead in that cellar. In the third chapter Mira returns to
the cellar and finds the missing ledger hidden under its floor. In the seventh
chapter Dorian confronts the killer in the same cellar, and the confession that
ends the story is spoken there. Every turning point of the mystery happens in
this one cellar.

## Containment summary

Aeltharûn contains Var Solethi. Var Solethi contains Or'Dahl. Or'Dahl contains
the Kingdom of Bael Turim. Bael Turim contains the Thornmarch. The Thornmarch
contains Kesh Amara. Kesh Amara contains the Obsidian Spire. The Obsidian Spire
contains the Warden's Chamber.
